bounded_remaining_claim: Across multiple preregistered, mutually code-disjoint public Honduras ONCAE-SEFIN cohorts, after exact contract/project-code blocking and compatible supplier identity, a fixed fail-closed documentary policy for the maximum claim CONTRACTOR_PAYMENT reduces unsupported payment attribution to zero without reducing recovery of supported payments, while preserving one-to-many contract-payment cardinality; the result is measured against strong baselines, monetary amount at risk, permutation controls and independent clean replay.
exclusive_predictions: Code plus supplier identity will still overpromote auxiliary, accounting-only, consortium-authority or object-conflicting events.
Adding payment nature and documentary object evidence will strictly reduce those unsupported promotions without reducing supported-payment recovery.
Rotating financial evidence across otherwise fixed pairs will materially degrade safety or recovery.
The safety-recovery result will persist on cohorts that exclude every previously evaluated shared code.
falsifiers: Any unsupported promotion by the fixed policy on a sealed cohort.
Any loss of supported-payment recovery relative to code plus supplier identity.
Failure on a code-disjoint replication cohort.
A primary source predating the cut date that reports the same bounded result with equivalent gates.
